import asyncio,json,time
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.dev import runtime
from scripts.experiments.followups import ExperimentDocker
from scripts.evidence.common import Artifacts

_,current=runtime.configure('exp39-20261014-r2')
runtime.compose(current,'down',timeout=90,capture_output=True,text=True)
run='exp39-20261014';env,state=runtime.configure(run)
a=Artifacts(runtime.ROOT/'artifacts'/run/'settled-preparation')
d=ExperimentDocker(state,a)
manifest=json.loads(next((runtime.ROOT/'artifacts'/run).glob('windows-*/manifest.json')).read_text())
d.frozen_images={c['service']:c['image_digest'] for c in manifest['images']}
d.profile('baseline')
d.compose('up','-d','--no-build','--pull','never','--wait','--wait-timeout','120','--scale','worker=3')
q=next((runtime.ROOT/'artifacts'/run).glob('windows-*'))
ids=[r['asset_id'] for line in (q/'submissions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if (r:=json.loads(line)).get('phase')=='r1-1-burst' and r.get('asset_id')]
assert len(ids)==12
code='''import asyncio,json,os,asyncpg
from uuid import UUID
async def main():
 c=await asyncpg.connect(os.environ['PROCESSING_POSTGRES_DSN'].replace('postgresql+asyncpg://','postgresql://'))
 counts=await c.fetch('SELECT state,count(*) n FROM attempts GROUP BY state')
 rows=await c.fetch("SELECT j.asset_id::text,j.id::text job_id,a.id::text attempt_id,a.state,j.source->>'sha256' source_sha256,(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(j.outputs) o WHERE o->>'kind'='primary') primary_outputs,(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(j.outputs) o WHERE o->>'kind'='hls_manifest') hls_outputs FROM jobs j JOIN attempts a ON j.current_attempt_id=a.id WHERE j.asset_id=ANY($1::uuid[])",[UUID(x) for x in IDS])
 print(json.dumps({'counts':[dict(x) for x in counts],'burst':[dict(x) for x in rows]}));await c.close()
asyncio.run(main())
'''.replace('IDS',repr(ids))
start=time.monotonic()
while time.monotonic()-start<300:
 data=json.loads(d.compose('exec','-T','processing','python','-c',code))
 if not any(x['state'] in ['queued','processing'] for x in data['counts']):break
 time.sleep(2)
else:raise RuntimeError('Retained preparation backlog did not settle within300s')
assert data['counts']==[{'state':'succeeded','n':68}]
assert len(data['burst'])==12 and all(x['state']=='succeeded' and x['primary_outputs']==1 and x['hls_outputs']==1 for x in data['burst'])
assert all(x['source_sha256']==json.loads((runtime.ROOT/'.local/experiment-fixtures/60/metadata.json').read_text())['sha256'] for x in data['burst'])
a.write('outcomes.json',{'scope':'Excluded preparation run','settlement_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,**data})
asyncio.run(d.drain())
runtime.compose(state,'down',timeout=90,capture_output=True,text=True)
print('Excluded preparation audit68/68successful; all experiment namespaces stopped',flush=True)

"""Start the saved original containers; never configure/write the parent checkout."""
import asyncio,hashlib,json,time
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.dev import runtime
from scripts.evidence import performance as p
from scripts.evidence.common import Artifacts,Client

inventory=json.loads((runtime.ROOT/'artifacts/exp38-20261014/original-demo.json').read_text())
assert len(inventory)==9 and {c['project'] for c in inventory}=={'dc2-local-e6eff6ee'}
assert not runtime.run(['docker','ps','-q'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
state=json.loads((runtime.common_root()/'.local/runs/local/state.json').read_text())
env=runtime.read_env(Path(state['env_file']))
a=Artifacts(runtime.ROOT/'artifacts/original-demo-restoration-20261014',[v for k,v in env.items() if any(s in k for s in ['PASSWORD','SECRET','TOKEN'])])
started=time.monotonic()
for services in [('postgres','redis','minio'),('media','processing','media-recovery','processing-recovery','worker','nginx')]:
 ids=[c['id'] for c in inventory if c['service'] in services]
 runtime.run(['docker','start',*ids],capture_output=True,text=True)
deadline=started+300
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
 data=json.loads(runtime.run(['docker','inspect',*[c['id'] for c in inventory]],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
 if all(c['State']['Running'] and c['State'].get('Health',{}).get('Status','healthy')=='healthy' for c in data):break
 time.sleep(1)
else:raise RuntimeError('Original demo did not become healthy within300s')
safe=[{'id':c['Id'],'service':c['Config']['Labels']['com.docker.compose.service'],'image':c['Image'],'revision':c['Config']['Labels'].get('org.opencontainers.image.revision'),'running':c['State']['Running'],'oom_killed':c['State']['OOMKilled']} for c in data]
assert {c['id']:c['image'] for c in safe}=={c['id']:c['image_digest'] for c in inventory}
assert all(not c['oom_killed'] for c in safe)
runtime.smoke(state)

async def workflow():
 owner=await p.owner(state,a,0)
 private=Client(f"http://127.0.0.1:{state['processing_port']}",headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+env['PROCESSING_SERVICE_TOKEN']})
 try:
  source=runtime.ROOT/'.local/experiment-fixtures/2/source.mp4';fixture=json.loads(source.with_name('metadata.json').read_text())
  asset=await p.upload(owner,source,artifacts=a,phase='original-demo-availability')
  jobs=await p.wait_jobs(private,owner,[asset],deadline=time.monotonic()+120,artifacts=a,phase='original-demo-availability',digest=fixture['sha256'])
  assert len(jobs)==1 and jobs[0]['state']=='succeeded' and jobs[0]['has_primary'] and jobs[0]['has_hls']
  result=await owner['client'].checked('GET','/api/jobs/'+asset)
  reply=await owner['client'].http.get(result['output_url'],follow_redirects=True)
  assert reply.status_code in [200,206]
  primary=reply.content
  assert len(primary)>0
  await owner['client'].checked('DELETE','/api/jobs/'+asset,expected=204)
  return {'public_workflow':'register/login/upload/process/primary-read/delete','asset_id':asset,'fixture_sha256':fixture['sha256'],'primary_read_bytes':len(primary),'primary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(primary).hexdigest(),'successful_attempt_id':jobs[0]['attempt_id'],'has_hls':True}
 finally:
  await private.close();await owner['client'].close()
result=asyncio.run(workflow())
a.write('restoration.json',{'status':'PASS','public_url':state['public_url'],'availability_restoration_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'original_exact_images_and_ids':True,'source_state':'Original accepted demo images; not a claim of rebuilt PR37 demo','containers':safe,'workflow':result,'original_and_historical_volumes_preserved':True})
print('Original demo restored at '+state['public_url']+'; exact original images/containers and public workflow PASS',flush=True)
